# Stoway **An inventory you can trust, in layers you can swap.** Pure-Luau CoreStore engine, server-authoritative orchestration, Fusion client: drag an item and it moves instantly, because the server already agreed. Use it as a base for RPG loadouts, survival backpacks, or utility-heavy tool systems. [Docs](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/) · [Releases](https://github.com/Zyn-ic/Stoway/releases)
## Features ### Hotbar - Drag and drop between hotbar and storage, including sweep paint-to-move on the Jailbreak layout. - Static slots or Dynamic packed display. - Keybinds on PC, button combos on console, tap to equip on touch. ### Storage - Items tracked as data (UUID-based), never live Tool instances. - Stacking, limits, sorting, and grouping by item type. - Optional backpack mode with its own popup. ### Systems - Server-authoritative state with delta replication and FullSync correction. - Per-team metadata, multi-skin UI, console and touch input. - Debug console (Studio only) for inventory, settings, skins, and teams. ## Built around | System | What | Read | |---|---|---| | **Categories** | Weapons, Consumables, Materials, Armor, Trinkets, Other: storage sections itself by item `Type` | [Metadata](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/metadata/) | | **Rarities** | Common → Uncommon → Rare → Epic → Legendary → Mythic → Special, with rank sort and slot-frame tints | [Metadata](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/metadata/) | | **Settings** | Hotbar type/slots, stacking + stack rules, backpack, limits (sparse-synced with a FullSync backstop) | [Settings](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/settings/) | | **Sorting** | Storage auto-sorts by name, type, or rarity rank (descending), hotbar never touched | [Settings](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/settings/) | | **Commands** | Conch debug console (Studio only): inventory ops, settings, skins, layouts, teams | [Debug Console](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/conch/) | ## Getting Started 1. Download the `.rbxm` (production = stripped, non-production = full) or the single playable `.rbxl` from [Releases](https://github.com/Zyn-ic/Stoway/releases). 2. Place server modules in `ServerScriptService`, client modules in `StarterPlayerScripts`, shared modules + `Packages` in `ReplicatedStorage`. 3. Boot the server: ```lua local Stoway = require(game.ServerScriptService.Services.StowayServerV3_0_0) local CoreStore = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.CoreStore) Stoway.Init(CoreStore) ``` 4. Press Play, open Conch (Backquote), try `help` then `inv`. New here? [Quickstart](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/quickstart/) → [Life of a swap](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/life-of-a-swap/) → [Building on top](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/building-on-top/). ## Documentation Full docs: [zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway](https://zyn-ic.github.io/Stoway/) (architecture, metadata, skins & layouts

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-09-19
--[[@description:
	Stoway world-drop pickup. Watches for Tools tagged "Stoway" (spawned
	by Stoway.Drop): strips default touch pickup, attaches a ProximityPrompt,
	picks up into the player's backpack on trigger (replicates to them),
	destroys unclaimed tools after 15s via Debris.
]]
-----------------------------
-- SERVICES --
-----------------------------

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

-----------------------------
-- DEPENDENCIES --
-----------------------------

local Stoway = require(ServerScriptService.Services.StowayServerV3_0_0)
local Log = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Log)

-----------------------------
-- CONSTANTS --
-----------------------------

local TAG = "Stoway"
local CLAIM_LIFETIME = 15

local configuredTools = setmetatable({} :: { [Tool]: boolean }, { __mode = "k" })
local pickupInProgress = setmetatable({} :: { [Tool]: boolean }, { __mode = "k" })

-----------------------------
-- PRIVATE FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- Metadata is everything on the tool except the attributes used to identify
-- the dropped item itself. Other attributes round-trip as item metadata.
local function readMetadata(tool: Tool): { [string]: any }
	local meta: { [string]: any } = {}
	for key, value in tool:GetAttributes() do
		if key ~= "UUID" and key ~= "Amount" and key ~= "Id" then
			meta[key] = value
		end
	end
	return meta
end

local function setup(tool: Tool)
	-- Only a descendant of Workspace is a live world drop and may receive a
	-- prompt or Debris timer. A tagged template can briefly exist elsewhere;
	-- Workspace.DescendantAdded below catches it when it becomes live.
	if not tool:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then return end
	if configuredTools[tool] then return end
	configuredTools[tool] = true

	-- The route strips already; this covers hand-placed tagged tools.
	-- Default touch pickup must never fire: the prompt is the only way in.
	local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") :: BasePart?
	if not handle then
		handle = tool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) :: BasePart?
	end
	if handle then
		local touch = handle:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest")
		if touch then touch:Destroy() end
		handle.CanTouch = false
	end

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Pick up"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Parent = handle or tool
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
		if tool.Parent == nil then return end
		if pickupInProgress[tool] then return end
		local id = tool:GetAttribute("Id")
		local amount = tool:GetAttribute("Amount")
		if typeof(id) ~= "string" then return end
		pickupInProgress[tool] = true
		local itemId: string = id
		local itemAmount: number = if typeof(amount) == "number" then amount else 1
		local res = Stoway.AddToBackpack(player, { Id = itemId, Amount = itemAmount, Metadata = readMetadata(tool) }, nil, true)
		if res.ok then
			tool:Destroy()
		else
			pickupInProgress[tool] = nil
			local pickupState = Stoway.get(player)
			Log.warn(pickupState and pickupState.Settings, `[StowayPickup] add failed for {player.Name}: {res.error.message}`)
		end
	end)

	Debris:AddItem(tool, CLAIM_LIFETIME)
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged(TAG) do
	if inst:IsA("Tool") then setup(inst) end
end
CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(TAG):Connect(function(inst: Instance)
	if inst:IsA("Tool") then setup(inst) end
end)

-- A Tool can inherit a CollectionService tag from a Studio template while it
-- is cloned into a Character or Backpack. In that case the tag-added signal
-- fires before the Tool reaches Workspace; catch the later parenting event so
-- the world-drop prompt is still installed.
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst: Instance)
	if inst:IsA("Tool") and CollectionService:HasTag(inst, TAG) then
		setup(inst)
	end
end)

Log.print(nil, "[StowayPickup] watching for tagged tools")

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-08-19
--[[@description:
	Client entry point. Boots from the server snapshot (FullSync pushed
	on join, requested as backup) and mounts the settings Layout /
	UiSkin pair. No mock data: without a snapshot the UI mounts empty.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local ClientStore = require("@self/Controller/ClientStore")
local ClientController = require("@self/Controller/ClientController")
local ClientEvents = require("@self/Controller/ClientEvents")
local NetworkClient = require("@self/Controller/NetworkClient")
local LayoutManager = require("@self/Controller/LayoutManager")
local CoreTypes = require("@self/CoreStore/Types")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Settings = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Settings)
local EngineTypes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.CoreStore.Types)
local Log = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Log)

-- Empty inventory with default settings. Indexes fill via hydrate.
-- Engine-shaped (not the slim client mirror): ClientController.Init
-- takes the full state; Stoway-level Settings is a compatible superset.
local function emptyState(): EngineTypes.InventoryState
	return {
		Items = {},
		ItemsByID = {},
		Hotbar = {},
		Storage = {},
		LocationByUUID = {},
		MetadataIndex = {},
		EquippedItemUUID = nil,
		Weight = 0,
		Settings = Settings.getDefault(),
	}
end

-- FullSync payload (no indexes, no Settings) into bootable state.
local function snapshotState(payload: CoreTypes.FullSyncPayload): EngineTypes.InventoryState
	local state = emptyState()
	state.Items = payload.Items
	for slot, uuid in payload.Hotbar do
		state.Hotbar[slot] = uuid
	end
	for idx, uuid in payload.Storage do
		state.Storage[idx] = uuid
	end
	state.EquippedItemUUID = payload.EquippedItemUUID
	if typeof(payload.Weight) == "number" then
		state.Weight = payload.Weight
	end
	return state
end

local StowayClient = {}
StowayClient.Store = ClientStore
StowayClient.Controller = ClientController
StowayClient.Events = ClientEvents

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

function StowayClient.Init()
	-- Replace the default backpack UI.
	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack, false)
	StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") :: PlayerGui

	-- Network first: subscriptions before anything can push, then ask
	-- for a snapshot to cover a missed join push. Always request: if
	-- the join push already went out, the server's per-player cooldown
	-- throttles this into a no-op instead of doubling the join.
	NetworkClient.RequestSnapshot()
	NetworkClient.Connect({
		Added = ClientController.ApplyServerAdded,
		Updated = ClientController.ApplyServerUpdated,
		Removed = ClientController.ApplyServerRemoved,
		Equipped = ClientController.ApplyServerEquipped,
		Unequipped = ClientController.ApplyServerUnequipped,
		FullSync = ClientController.ApplyServerFullSync,
		LayoutChanged = function(hotbarTypeKey: string, skinKey: string)
			LayoutManager.SetLayout(
				ClientStore.RootScope,
				playerGui,
				ClientStore,
				hotbarTypeKey,
				skinKey
			)
			Log.print(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[StowayClientV3] layout changed to {hotbarTypeKey} / {skinKey}`)
		end,
		-- Engine settings replicate sparsely per change (chat debug today,
		-- any server flow tomorrow). Funnels through the controller (not the
		-- store directly) so _state stays in sync: later sync() calls then
		-- re-apply these values instead of clobbering atoms with the boot
		-- snapshot. Atoms drive every view, so this rebuilds the whole UI.
		SettingsChanged = function(patch)
			ClientController.ApplyServerSettings(patch)
			Log.print(ClientStore.GetSettings(), "[StowayClientV3] settings updated from server")
		end,
	})

	-- Boot from the server snapshot. The join push usually lands before
	-- this runs; the request covers the race. Empty (never mock) when
	-- the server stays silent — a later FullSync still fills the UI.
	local snapshot = NetworkClient.GetLastFullSync()
	local state: EngineTypes.InventoryState
	if snapshot then
		state = snapshotState(snapshot)
	else
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), "[StowayClientV3] no snapshot from server, mounting empty")
		state = emptyState()
	end
	ClientController.Init(state)

	-- Join-push race cover: if a FullSync (with settings) landed before
	-- Init, mirror it now; later pushes apply through the normal path.
	local bootSnap = NetworkClient.GetLastFullSync()
	if bootSnap and typeof(bootSnap.Settings) == "table" then
		ClientController.ApplyServerSettings(bootSnap.Settings)
	end

	-- Single source of truth: Settings.Layout selects the HotbarType
	-- engine, Settings.UiSkin the loader key (1:1 asset contract for
	-- prefab skins in LayoutManager; code-built skins ignore the name).
	local settings = ClientStore.GetSettings()
	local layoutKey: string = (settings and settings.Layout) or "StandardHotbarStorage"
	local uiSkin: string = (settings and settings.UiSkin) or "Default"
	LayoutManager.SetLayout(ClientStore.RootScope, playerGui, ClientStore, layoutKey, uiSkin)

	Log.print(settings, `[StowayClientV3] core initialized (server snapshot, {layoutKey} / {uiSkin})`)
end

function StowayClient.GetStore()
	return ClientStore
end

function StowayClient.GetController()
	return ClientController
end

function StowayClient.GetEvents()
	return ClientEvents
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return StowayClient

local SignalPlus = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.SignalPlus)

local PlayerServiceSignals = {}
PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrHasDied = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<Player>
PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrAdded = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<Player>
PlayerServiceSignals.BindToCharAdded = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<Player, Model>
PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrRemoving = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<Player>

return PlayerServiceSignals

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-05-19
--[[@description:
	Player lifecycle service handling add/remove/character/death.
	Fires PlayerServiceSignals for other systems to hook into.
]]
-----------------------------
-- SERVICES --
-----------------------------

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")

-----------------------------
-- DEPENDENCIES --
-----------------------------

local Janitor = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Janitor)
local PlayerServiceSignals = require(ServerScriptService.Libraries.PlayerServiceSignals)

-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

type PlayerRecord = {
	IsDead: boolean,
	Janitor: any,
}

local serviceJanitor = Janitor.new()
local playerRecords: {[Player]: PlayerRecord} = {}

-----------------------------
-- PRIVATE FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

local function debugPrint(message: string)
	print(("[PlayerService][%.3f] %s"):format(workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), message))
end

local function getHumanoid(character: Model): Humanoid?
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		return humanoid
	end

	local found = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
	if found and found:IsA("Humanoid") then
		return found
	end

	return nil
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player: Player, character: Model)
	local record = playerRecords[player]
	if not record then
		return
	end

	record.IsDead = false
	debugPrint(("character added: %s"):format(player.Name))
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToCharAdded:Fire(player, character)

	local humanoid = getHumanoid(character)
	if not humanoid then
		warn(("[PlayerService] missing humanoid for %s"):format(player.Name))
		return
	end

	record.Janitor:Add(humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		record.IsDead = true
		debugPrint(("player died: %s"):format(player.Name))
		PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrHasDied:Fire(player)
	end), "Disconnect")
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	if playerRecords[player] then
		return
	end

	local playerJanitor = Janitor.new()
	playerRecords[player] = {
		IsDead = false,
		Janitor = playerJanitor,
	}

	debugPrint(("player added: %s"):format(player.Name))
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrAdded:Fire(player)

	playerJanitor:Add(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end), "Disconnect")

	if player.Character then
		task.defer(onCharacterAdded, player, player.Character)
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	local record = playerRecords[player]
	if not record then
		return
	end

	debugPrint(("player removing: %s"):format(player.Name))
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrRemoving:Fire(player)

	record.Janitor:Cleanup()
	playerRecords[player] = nil
end

-----------------------------
-- HANDLERS --
-----------------------------

serviceJanitor:Add(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded), "Disconnect")
serviceJanitor:Add(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving), "Disconnect")

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.defer(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

game:BindToClose(function()
	serviceJanitor:Cleanup()

	for _, record in playerRecords do
		record.Janitor:Cleanup()
	end

	table.clear(playerRecords)

	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrAdded:DisconnectAll()
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToCharAdded:DisconnectAll()
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrHasDied:DisconnectAll()
	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrRemoving:DisconnectAll()
end)

--!strict

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-09-18
--[[@description:
	Generic client UI event bus (Layer 1). Fixed minimal payloads
	(slotType, index, uuid) typed once with SignalPlus, stable forever.
	External systems subscribe here; skin HookFuncs modules are
	privileged subscribers invoked directly at call sites (Layer 2),
	never through this bus. See docs/specs/ClientEvents.md.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SignalPlus = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.SignalPlus)

local CoreTypes = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)

local ClientEvents = {}

-----------------------------
-- SIGNALS --
-----------------------------

-- Payloads never contain frames, buttons, or scopes. Subscribers
-- resolve visuals themselves.
ClientEvents.SlotClicked = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number, string?>
ClientEvents.SlotHovered = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.DragStarted = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.DragEnded = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.Equipped = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.Unequipped = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.ItemAdded = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.ItemRemoved = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.Swapped = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number, CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.Selected = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>
ClientEvents.Deselected = SignalPlus() :: SignalPlus.Signal<CoreTypes.SlotType, number>

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- Invoke one skin hook function defensively. Always task.spawn'd: stock
-- hooks yield (OnSlotHover task.waits twice), so a synchronous call
-- would stall the input/drag thread. pcall'd: a throwing hook warns
-- once and never breaks inventory.
function ClientEvents.CallHook(hooks: CoreTypes.HookMap?, hookName: string, ...: unknown)
	if hooks == nil then return end
	local fn = hooks[hookName]
	if typeof(fn) ~= "function" then return end
	local invoke = fn :: (...unknown) -> ()
	local args = table.pack(...)
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			invoke(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn(`[ClientEvents] hook '{hookName}' threw`)
		end
	end)
end

function ClientEvents.Destroy()
	ClientEvents.SlotClicked:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.SlotHovered:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.DragStarted:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.DragEnded:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.Equipped:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.Unequipped:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.ItemAdded:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.ItemRemoved:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.Swapped:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.Selected:DisconnectAll()
	ClientEvents.Deselected:DisconnectAll()
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return ClientEvents

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-08-19
--[[@description:
	Reactive state mirror of the server InventoryState. Holds RootScope and
	top-level atoms. Pure lookups are in CoreStore/Query.luau.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.fusion)

local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)
local Query = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Query)
local Settings = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Settings)

local ClientStore = {}

-----------------------------
-- ROOT SCOPE + ATOMS --
-----------------------------

ClientStore.RootScope = Fusion.scoped(Fusion)

local Scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)> = ClientStore.RootScope

local initialItems: { [string]: Types.Item } = {}
local initialHotbar: { [number]: string? } = {}
local initialStorage: { string } = {}
local initialEquippedItemUUID: string? = nil
local initialSettings: Types.Settings? = nil

ClientStore.Items = Scope:Value(initialItems)
ClientStore.Hotbar = Scope:Value(initialHotbar)
ClientStore.Storage = Scope:Value(initialStorage)
ClientStore.EquippedItemUUID = Scope:Value(initialEquippedItemUUID)
ClientStore.Weight = Scope:Value(0)
ClientStore.Settings = Scope:Value(initialSettings)

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- Populates atoms from a full snapshot. Clones tables so Fusion sees new refs
-- and future in-place mutations of snapshot don't alias the Value interior.
function ClientStore.Init(snapshot: Types.InventoryState)
	ClientStore.Items:set(table.clone(snapshot.Items))
	ClientStore.Hotbar:set(table.clone(snapshot.Hotbar))
	ClientStore.Storage:set(table.clone(snapshot.Storage))
	ClientStore.EquippedItemUUID:set(snapshot.EquippedItemUUID)
	ClientStore.Weight:set(snapshot.Weight)
	ClientStore.SetEngineSettings(snapshot.Settings)
end

function ClientStore.SetEngineSettings(settings: Types.EngineSettings)
	local clientSettings = Settings.getDefault()
	clientSettings.HotbarType = settings.HotbarType
	clientSettings.MaxHotbarSlots = settings.MaxHotbarSlots
	clientSettings.Limit = settings.Limit
	clientSettings.CanStack = settings.CanStack
	clientSettings.MaxStackSize = settings.MaxStackSize
	clientSettings.BackpackEnabled = settings.BackpackEnabled
	clientSettings.Sorting = settings.Sorting
	clientSettings.SortOrder = settings.SortOrder
	clientSettings.StackOnSwap = settings.StackOnSwap
	clientSettings.StackRequiredFields = table.clone(settings.StackRequiredFields)
	clientSettings.StackBlacklist = table.clone(settings.StackBlacklist)
	clientSettings.DefaultDroppable = settings.DefaultDroppable
	clientSettings.DebugLogs = settings.DebugLogs
	ClientStore.Settings:set(clientSettings)
end

function ClientStore.GetSnapshot(): Types.InventoryState
	local items: { [string]: Types.Item } = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.Items)
	local hotbar: { [number]: string? } = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.Hotbar)
	local storage: { string } = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.Storage)
	local equipped: string? = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.EquippedItemUUID)
	local weight: number = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.Weight)
	local settings: Types.Settings = Fusion.peek(ClientStore.Settings) or Settings.getDefault()
	return {
		Items = items,
		ItemsByID = {},

	rootScope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>,
	playerGui: PlayerGui,
	store: typeof(ClientStore),
	hotbarTypeKey: string,
	skinKey: string
)
	local engine = Layouts[hotbarTypeKey]
	if not engine then
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[LayoutManager] unknown HotbarType layout '{hotbarTypeKey}'`)
		return
	end

	local skinLoader = Skins[skinKey]
	if not skinLoader then
		warn(`[LayoutManager] unknown UiSkin '{skinKey}'`)
		return
	end

	LayoutManager.Teardown()

	local layoutScope = rootScope:deriveScope() :: Fusion.Scope
	currentLayoutScope = layoutScope
	currentLayoutKey = hotbarTypeKey
	currentSkinKey = skinKey

	-- a key can only resolve its own GUI folder, never another skin's.
	local skinAssetName = skinKey

	if not skin then
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[LayoutManager] skin '{skinKey}' failed to load asset '{skinAssetName}' — layout not mounted`)

		currentLayoutKey = nil

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-09-19
--[[@description:
	Client network layer. Sends are one direct FireServer per operation
	(single-table payloads per the wire convention). Listens are the
	server pushes (Added/Updated/Removed/Equipped/Unequipped/FullSync),
	applied through injected ClientController server-apply paths — never
	echoed back. Revert is log-only. Snapshot boot reads the last
	received FullSync. Connect() runs once at boot.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.StowayRemotes)

local CoreTypes = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)
local SharedCoreTypes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.CoreStore.Types)
local ClientStore = require(script.Parent.ClientStore)
local Log = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Log)

-- One any for the whole QuickNet seam, and why it earns its place:
-- QuickNet infers callback payloads and FireServer params from the
-- *schema tables* (schema nominals like AddedPayload/SlotRef), while
-- game code uses the *domain nominals* (CoreStore Item/SlotRef). Same
-- shapes, different identities — the new solver rejects the crossing.
-- Serialization genuinely erases types here, so a single any-binding
-- is honest. Everything past it (handlers, applies, state) stays typed.
local R: any = Remotes

local NetworkClient = {}

local function settings()
	return ClientStore.GetSettings()
end

-- Server-apply handlers, injected by init.luau. Concrete signatures
-- matching ClientController.ApplyServer* exactly; injected (never
-- required) so the dependency stays one-directional.
export type ApplyHandlers = {
	Added: (uuid: string, item: SharedCoreTypes.Item, slotType: string?, slot: number?) -> (),
	Updated: (uuid: string, newAmount: number) -> (),
	Removed: (uuid: string, amount: number?) -> (),
	Equipped: (uuid: string) -> (),
	Unequipped: () -> (),
	FullSync: (payload: CoreTypes.FullSyncPayload) -> (),
	LayoutChanged: (hotbarTypeKey: string, skinKey: string) -> (),
	SettingsChanged: (patch: SharedCoreTypes.SettingsOverrides) -> (),
}

local _applies: ApplyHandlers? = nil
local _lastFullSync: CoreTypes.FullSyncPayload? = nil

type Connection = { Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> () }

local _conns: { Connection } = {}

-----------------------------
-- PRIVATE FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- One serialization guard for every send. Thunk keeps the call fully
-- typed at the call site; pcall takes a single target so any return
-- shape is fine on both solvers.
local function send(name: string, fn: () -> ())
	if not pcall(fn) then
		Log.warn(settings(), `[NetworkClient] {name} send failed`)
	end
end

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

function NetworkClient.SendAddItem(itemInput: CoreTypes.ItemInput, opts: CoreTypes.AddOptions?)
	send("AddItem", function()
		R.AddItem:FireServer({ input = itemInput, options = opts })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendAddToBackpack(itemInput: CoreTypes.ItemInput, opts: CoreTypes.AddOptions?)
	send("AddToBackpack", function()
		R.AddToBackpack:FireServer({ input = itemInput, options = opts })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendAddToHotbar(itemInput: CoreTypes.ItemInput, preferredSlot: number?)
	send("AddToHotbar", function()
		R.AddToHotbar:FireServer({ input = itemInput, preferredSlot = preferredSlot })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendRemoveItem(uuid: string, amount: number?)
	send("RemoveItem", function()
		R.RemoveItem:FireServer({ uuid = uuid, amount = amount })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendSwap(from: CoreTypes.SlotRef, to: CoreTypes.SlotRef)
	send("SwapSlots", function()
		R.SwapSlots:FireServer({
			from = { Type = from.Type, Slot = from.Slot },
			to = { Type = to.Type, Slot = to.Slot },
		})
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendSwapStack(from: CoreTypes.SlotRef, to: CoreTypes.SlotRef)
	send("SwapStack", function()
		R.SwapStack:FireServer({
			from = { Type = from.Type, Slot = from.Slot },
			to = { Type = to.Type, Slot = to.Slot },
		})
	end)
end

	send("Move", function()
		R.Move:FireServer({
			from = { Type = from.Type, Slot = from.Slot },
			to = { Type = to.Type, Slot = to.Slot },
		})
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendSplit(uuid: string, amount: number, dest: CoreTypes.SlotRef?)
	send("Split", function()
		if dest then
			R.Split:FireServer({ uuid = uuid, amount = amount, dest = { Type = dest.Type, Slot = dest.Slot } })
		else
			R.Split:FireServer({ uuid = uuid, amount = amount })
		end
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendEquip(uuid: string)
	send("EquipSlot", function()
		R.EquipSlot:FireServer({ uuid = uuid })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendUnequip()
	send("UnequipSlot", function()
		R.UnequipSlot:FireServer()
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendUpdateMetadata(uuid: string, updates: CoreTypes.MetadataUpdates)
	send("UpdateMetadata", function()
		R.UpdateMetadata:FireServer({ uuid = uuid, updates = updates })
	end)
end


function NetworkClient.SendSort()
	send("Sort", function()
		R.Sort:FireServer()
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.SendDrop(uuid: string, amount: number?)
	send("Drop", function()
		R.Drop:FireServer({ uuid = uuid, amount = amount })
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.RequestSnapshot()
	send("RequestInventorySync", function()
		R.RequestInventorySync:FireServer()
	end)
end

-- Server pushes -> injected apply handlers. A malformed push warns,
-- never breaks local inventory.
function NetworkClient.Connect(applies: ApplyHandlers)
	NetworkClient.Disconnect()
	_applies = applies
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryAdded.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		if not pcall(_applies.Added, payload.uuid, payload.item, payload.slotType, payload.slot) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerAdded failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryUpdated.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		if not pcall(_applies.Updated, payload.uuid, payload.newAmount) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerUpdated failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryRemoved.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		-- pcall threads the handler's arity: pass the optional amount
		-- explicitly or the new solver rejects the call.
		if not pcall(_applies.Removed, payload.uuid, nil) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerRemoved failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryEquipped.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		-- uuid is schema-optional (shared with Unequipped's shape).
		if typeof(payload.uuid) ~= "string" then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] Equipped push without uuid, skipping")
			return
		end
		if not pcall(_applies.Equipped, payload.uuid) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerEquipped failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryUnequipped.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
		if not _applies then return end
		if not pcall(_applies.Unequipped) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerUnequipped failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryRevert.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		Log.warn(settings(), `[NetworkClient] server revert (log-only): {tostring(payload.fromSlot)}`)
		-- Log-only by design: the server's handle() already pushes a
		-- FullSync behind every failed op, so requesting another snapshot
		-- here would triple-send (revert + handle push + requested push).
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.InventoryFullSync.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload: CoreTypes.FullSyncPayload)
		_lastFullSync = payload
		if not _applies then return end
		if not pcall(_applies.FullSync, payload) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerFullSync failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.LayoutChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		if typeof(payload.layout) ~= "string" or typeof(payload.skin) ~= "string" then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] invalid layout change payload")
			return
		end
		if not pcall(_applies.LayoutChanged, payload.layout, payload.skin) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerLayoutChanged failed")
		end
	end)
	_conns[#_conns + 1] = R.SettingsChanged.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if not _applies then return end
		if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] invalid settings payload")
			return
		end
		if not pcall(_applies.SettingsChanged, payload) then
			Log.warn(settings(), "[NetworkClient] ApplyServerSettingsChanged failed")
		end
	end)
end

function NetworkClient.GetLastFullSync(): CoreTypes.FullSyncPayload?
	return _lastFullSync
end

function NetworkClient.Disconnect()
	_applies = nil
	for _, conn in _conns do
		conn:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(_conns)
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return NetworkClient

local Types = require("./Types")

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --

function Query.getItem(items: { [string]: Types.Item }, uuid: string?): Types.Item?
	if not uuid then
		return nil
	end
	return items[uuid]
end

function Query.getHotbarUUID(hotbar: { [number]: string? }, slot: number): string?
	return hotbar[slot]
end

function Query.getStorageUUID(storage: { string }, index: number): string?
	return storage[index]
end

function Query.isEquipped(equippedUUID: string?, uuid: string?): boolean
	return equippedUUID ~= nil and uuid ~= nil and equippedUUID == uuid
end

-- Linear scan over hotbar and storage.
function Query.findSlotByUUID(
	hotbar: { [number]: string? },
	storage: { string },
	uuid: string
): (Types.SlotType?, number?)
	for slot, hotbarUUID in hotbar do
		if hotbarUUID == uuid then
			return "Hotbar", slot
		end
	end
	for index, storageUUID in storage do
		if storageUUID == uuid then
			return "Storage", index
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function Query.isDynamicHotbar(settings: Types.Settings?): boolean
	return settings ~= nil and settings.HotbarType == "Dynamic"
end

-- Packed position for Dynamic hotbars; holes map past the end.
function Query.packedHotbarOrder(
	hotbar: { [number]: string? },
	items: { [string]: Types.Item },
	slot: number,
	isDynamic: boolean
): number
	if not isDynamic then
		return slot
	end
	local uuid = hotbar[slot]
	if not uuid or not items[uuid] then
		return 1000 + slot
	end
	local visible = 0
	for i = 1, slot do
		local u = hotbar[i]
		if u and items[u] then
			visible += 1
		end
	end
	return visible
end

function Query.isHotbarSlotVisible(
	hotbar: { [number]: string? },
	items: { [string]: Types.Item },
	slot: number,
	isDynamic: boolean
): boolean
	if not isDynamic then
		return true
	end
	local uuid = hotbar[slot]
	return uuid ~= nil and items[uuid] ~= nil
end

-- Groups Storage by item type for display; original order preserved.
Query.UNGROUPED_KEY = ""

function Query.groupStorageByType(
	storage: { string },
	items: { [string]: Types.Item },
	groupByCategory: boolean
): Types.GroupedStorage
	if not groupByCategory then
		local flat: { Types.ItemRecord } = {}
		for index, uuid in storage do
			table.insert(flat, { index = index, uuid = uuid })
		end
		return { [Query.UNGROUPED_KEY] = flat }
	end

	local groups: Types.GroupedStorage = {}
	for index, uuid in storage do
		local item = items[uuid]
		local itemType = if item and item.Metadata and item.Metadata.Type then item.Metadata.Type else "Other"
		local group = groups[itemType]
		if not group then
			group = {}
			groups[itemType] = group
		end
		table.insert(group, { index = index, uuid = uuid })
	end
	return groups
end

-- Group order by category Order, then alphabetically.
function Query.orderedGroupKeys(
	groups: Types.GroupedStorage,
	categories: { [string]: Types.CategoryDef }?
): { string }
	local keys: { string } = {}
	for itemType in groups do
		table.insert(keys, itemType)
	end
	table.sort(keys, function(a, b)
		local ca = categories and categories[a]
		local cb = categories and categories[b]
		local oa = if ca then ca.Order else math.huge
		local ob = if cb then cb.Order else math.huge
		if oa ~= ob then
			return oa < ob
		end
		return a < b
	end)
	return keys
end

function Query.formatWeight(weight: number, limit: number): string
	if limit <= 0 then
		return tostring(weight)
	end
	return `{weight}/{limit}`
end

-- Abbreviated stack count (e.g. 1.3k, 2m).
function Query.formatAmount(amount: number): string
	if amount < 1000 then
		return tostring(amount) .. "x"
	end
	local units = {
		{ threshold = 1e9, suffix = "b" },
		{ threshold = 1e6, suffix = "m" },
		{ threshold = 1e3, suffix = "k" },
	}
	for _, unit in units do
		if amount >= unit.threshold then
			local scaled = math.floor(amount / unit.threshold * 10 + 0.5) / 10
			if scaled >= 1000 then
				if unit.suffix == "k" then
					return "1m"
				elseif unit.suffix == "m" then
					return "1b"
				end
				return string.format("%.0f", scaled) .. unit.suffix
			end
			if scaled == math.floor(scaled) then
				return string.format("%.0f", scaled) .. unit.suffix
			end
			return string.format("%.1f", scaled) .. unit.suffix
		end
	end
	return tostring(amount)
end

-- Case-insensitive match on Id and Description.
function Query.matchesSearch(item: Types.Item?, searchText: string): boolean
	if searchText == "" then
		return true
	end
	if not item then
		return false
	end
	local needle = string.lower(searchText)
	if string.find(string.lower(item.Id), needle, 1, true) then
		return true
	end
	local description = item.Metadata and item.Metadata.Description
	if description and string.find(string.lower(description), needle, 1, true) then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function Query.filterRecordsBySearch(
	records: { Types.ItemRecord },
	items: { [string]: Types.Item },
	searchText: string
): { Types.ItemRecord }
	if searchText == "" then
		return records
	end
	local filtered: { Types.ItemRecord } = {}
	for _, record in records do
		if Query.matchesSearch(items[record.uuid], searchText) then
			table.insert(filtered, record)
		end
	end
	return filtered
end

-- Sorts records by SortOrder; stable by original index.
function Query.sortRecords(
	records: { Types.ItemRecord },
	items: { [string]: Types.Item },
	sortOrder: Types.SortOrder
): { Types.ItemRecord }
	if sortOrder == "None" then
		return records
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(records)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a: Types.ItemRecord, b: Types.ItemRecord)
		local itemA = items[a.uuid]
		local itemB = items[b.uuid]
		if sortOrder == "Name" then
			local nameA: string = if itemA then itemA.Id else ""
			local nameB: string = if itemB then itemB.Id else ""
			if nameA ~= nameB then
				return nameA < nameB
			end
		elseif sortOrder == "Rarity" then
			local rankA = Colors.getRarityRank(itemA and itemA.Metadata and itemA.Metadata.Rarity)
			local rankB = Colors.getRarityRank(itemB and itemB.Metadata and itemB.Metadata.Rarity)
			if rankA ~= rankB then
				return rankA > rankB -- highest rarity first
			end
		elseif sortOrder == "ItemType" then
			local typeA = if itemA and itemA.Metadata and itemA.Metadata.Type then itemA.Metadata.Type else "Other"
			local typeB = if itemB and itemB.Metadata and itemB.Metadata.Type then itemB.Metadata.Type else "Other"
			if typeA ~= typeB then
				return typeA < typeB
			end
		end
		return a.index < b.index
	end)
	return sorted
end

-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return Query

	count, rarity color, equipped state and keybind. Used by all layouts.

-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.fusion)
local Colors = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Colors)

local CoreTypes = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)
local Query = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Query)
local ClientStore = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controller.ClientStore)
local ClientController = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controller.ClientController)
local ClientEvents = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controller.ClientEvents)
local PointerDragService = require(script.Parent.Parent.Interactions.PointerDragService)

local SlotView = {}

-----------------------------
-- TYPES --
-----------------------------

export type DragLike = PointerDragService.Service

export type SlotProps = {
	SlotType: CoreTypes.SlotType,
	SlotIndex: number,
	Parent: Instance,
	Template: Frame,
	Store: typeof(ClientStore),
	ShowKeybind: boolean?,
	HasBind: boolean?,
	HideChrome: { string }?,
	PackOrder: Fusion.Computed<number>?,
	Keybind: Fusion.Computed<string>?,
	Visibility: Fusion.Computed<boolean>?,
	DragService: DragLike?,
	Hooks: CoreTypes.HookMap?,
}

local UNBOUND_KEYBIND_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 85, 85)

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

function SlotView.Create(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>, props: SlotProps): Frame
	local slotFrame = props.Template:Clone()
	slotFrame.Name = props.SlotType .. "-" .. tostring(props.SlotIndex)
	slotFrame.Parent = props.Parent
	table.insert(scope, slotFrame)

	local store = props.Store

	-- Skin-declared chrome visibility: hide listed direct children (deco
	-- overlays) per slot type. Ghost inherits via clone, so ghost/live stay
	-- consistent. Absent list = everything visible (legacy behavior).
	local hideChrome: { string }? = props.HideChrome
	if hideChrome then
		for _, name in hideChrome do
			local node = slotFrame:FindFirstChild(name)
			if node and node:IsA("GuiObject") then node.Visible = false end
		end
	end

	local slotbutton = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("slotbutton") :: ImageButton?
	local stackcount = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("stackcount") :: TextLabel?
	local slotnumber = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("slotnumber") :: TextLabel?
	local selecticon = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("selecticon") :: GuiObject?
	local rarityframe = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("rarityframe") :: ImageLabel?

	local hotbarSlotUUID = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string?
		local hotbar: { [number]: string? } = use(store.Hotbar)
		return Query.getHotbarUUID(hotbar, props.SlotIndex)
	end)

	local storageSlotUUID = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string?
		local storage: { string } = use(store.Storage)
		return Query.getStorageUUID(storage, props.SlotIndex)
	end)

	local slotUUID = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string?
		if props.SlotType == "Hotbar" then
			return use(hotbarSlotUUID)
		end
		return use(storageSlotUUID)
	end)

	local currentItem = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): CoreTypes.Item?
		local items: { [string]: CoreTypes.Item } = use(store.Items)
		local uuid: string? = use(slotUUID)
		return Query.getItem(items, uuid)
	end)

	local hasItem = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
		return use(currentItem) ~= nil
	end)

	local isEquipped = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
		local uuid: string? = use(slotUUID)
		local equipped: string? = use(store.EquippedItemUUID)
		return Query.isEquipped(equipped, uuid)
	end)

	local hasImage = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
		local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
		return item ~= nil and item.Metadata ~= nil and item.Metadata.Image ~= nil and item.Metadata.Image ~= ""
	end)

	local fallbackText = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string
		local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
		if not item then return "" end
		local id = item.Id or "?"
		if #id > 12 then return string.sub(id, 1, 10) .. ".." end
		return id
	end)

	if slotbutton then
		local fallbackLabel = scope:New("TextLabel") {
			Name = "fallbacklabel",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.72),
			ZIndex = 2,
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			TextScaled = true,
			TextWrapped = true,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2,
			TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Parent = slotbutton,
		}
		scope:New("UITextSizeConstraint") {
			MaxTextSize = 18,
			MinTextSize = 7,
			Parent = fallbackLabel,
		}
		scope:New("UIPadding") {
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8),
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4),
			Parent = fallbackLabel,
		}

		scope:Hydrate(slotbutton) {
			Image = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				return if item and item.Metadata then item.Metadata.Image or "" else ""
			end),
			ImageTransparency = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): number
				return if use(hasImage) then 0 else 1
			end),
			Visible = hasItem,
		}

		scope:Hydrate(fallbackLabel) {
			Text = fallbackText,
			Visible = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
				return use(hasItem) and not use(hasImage)
			end),
			TextColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): Color3
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				-- Use rarity tint for fallback text so color-blind still has Id, but hue helps
				return Colors.getRarityColor(item and item.Metadata and item.Metadata.Rarity)
			end),
		}

		-- Tap/Activated to equip (covers Mouse, Touch, and Gamepad ButtonA via
		-- GuiService.SelectedObject + Activated). Guard against firing right
		-- after a drag so a drag-release doesn't also equip.
		local dragService = props.DragService
		table.insert(
			scope,
			slotbutton.Activated:Connect(function()
				if dragService ~= nil then
					if dragService:IsDragging() then return end
					if dragService:WasRecentlyDragging(0.25) then return end
				end
				local uuid: string? = Fusion.peek(slotUUID)
				if not uuid then return end
				local has: boolean = Fusion.peek(hasItem)
				if not has then return end
				ClientEvents.SlotClicked:Fire(props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex, uuid)
				ClientEvents.CallHook(props.Hooks, "OnSlotClick", props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex, uuid)
				local equipped: string? = Fusion.peek(store.EquippedItemUUID)
				if equipped == uuid then
					ClientController.Unequip()
				else
					ClientController.Equip(uuid)
				end
			end)
		)

		-- Hover hook: fires on hover begin. Skin function is spawned
		-- (stock OnSlotHover yields on its tween), never blocking input.
		table.insert(
			scope,
			slotbutton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
				ClientEvents.SlotHovered:Fire(props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
				ClientEvents.CallHook(props.Hooks, "OnSlotHover", slotbutton, props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
			end)
		)

	end

	if rarityframe then
		-- Tint both channels: ImageColor3 drives image-art frames, BackgroundColor3
		-- drives native bars (imageless templates tint via background).
		local rarityColor: Fusion.Computed<Color3> = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): Color3
			local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
			return Colors.getRarityColor(item and item.Metadata and item.Metadata.Rarity)
		end)
		scope:Hydrate(rarityframe) {
			ImageColor3 = rarityColor,
			BackgroundColor3 = rarityColor,
			Visible = hasItem,
		}
	end

	-- Team ring: any template with a "teamframe" child gets its
	-- BackgroundColor3 driven by Metadata.Team (Jailbreak-style layouts).
	-- Templates without the child are untouched.
	local teamframe = slotFrame:FindFirstChild("teamframe") :: GuiObject?
	if teamframe then
		scope:Hydrate(teamframe) {
			BackgroundColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): Color3
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				local raw = if item and item.Metadata then item.Metadata.Team else nil
				return Colors.getTeamColor(if typeof(raw) == "string" then raw else nil)
			end),
			Visible = hasItem,
		}
	end

	if stackcount then
		-- Keep badge inside the cell and tilted for readability.
		if props.SlotType == "Storage" then
			stackcount.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
			stackcount.Position = UDim2.new(1, -3, 1, -3)
			stackcount.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 22)
			stackcount.ZIndex = 3
			stackcount.Rotation = -15
		elseif props.SlotType == "Hotbar" then
			stackcount.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
			stackcount.Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2)
			stackcount.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 18)
			stackcount.ZIndex = 3
			stackcount.Rotation = -15
		else
			stackcount.Rotation = -15
		end
		scope:Hydrate(stackcount) {
			Visible = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				return item ~= nil and item.Amount > 1
			end),
			Text = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): string
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				if item then
					return Query.formatAmount(item.Amount)
				end
				return ""
			end),
		}
	end

	if slotnumber then
		-- Captured once: live reads as Computed fallbacks self-perpetuate.
		local defaultNumberColor: Color3 = slotnumber.TextColor3
		scope:Hydrate(slotnumber) {
			Text = props.Keybind or "",
			Visible = props.ShowKeybind == true,
			TextColor3 = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): Color3
				-- Unbound keeps the legacy red badge.
				if props.HasBind == false then return UNBOUND_KEYBIND_COLOR end
				local item: CoreTypes.Item? = use(currentItem)
				local raw = if item and item.Metadata then item.Metadata.Team else nil
				if typeof(raw) == "string" then
					return Colors.getTeamColor(raw)
				end
				return defaultNumberColor
			end),
		}
	end

	if selecticon then
		-- Visual feedback via Fusion tween: tiny delay then Back pop on equip,
		-- instant off on unequip. isEquipped stays source of truth.
		local origSize: UDim2 = selecticon.Size
		local origTransparency: number = 0
		if selecticon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			origTransparency = selecticon.ImageTransparency
		end
		local smallSize = UDim2.new(origSize.X.Scale * 0.85, origSize.X.Offset, origSize.Y.Scale * 0.85, origSize.Y.Offset)
		local equipProgress: Fusion.Value<number> = scope:Value(0)
		local tweened: Fusion.Tween<number> = scope:Tween(
			equipProgress,
			TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out, 0, false, 0.06)
		)
		local popSize: Fusion.Computed<UDim2> = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): UDim2
			local t: number = use(tweened)
			local sx: number = smallSize.X.Scale + (origSize.X.Scale - smallSize.X.Scale) * t
			local sy: number = smallSize.Y.Scale + (origSize.Y.Scale - smallSize.Y.Scale) * t
			return UDim2.new(sx, origSize.X.Offset, sy, origSize.Y.Offset)
		end)
		local popTransparency: Fusion.Computed<number> = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): number
			local t: number = use(tweened)
			return 1 + (origTransparency - 1) * t
		end)
		scope:Hydrate(selecticon) {
			Visible = isEquipped,
			Size = popSize,
			ImageTransparency = popTransparency,
		}
		if Fusion.peek(isEquipped) then equipProgress:set(1) end
		scope:Observer(isEquipped):onChange(function()
			if Fusion.peek(isEquipped) then
				equipProgress:set(1)
				ClientEvents.Selected:Fire(props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
				ClientEvents.CallHook(props.Hooks, "OnSelect", slotFrame, props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
			else
				equipProgress:set(0)
				ClientEvents.Deselected:Fire(props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
				ClientEvents.CallHook(props.Hooks, "OnDeselect", slotFrame, props.SlotType, props.SlotIndex)
			end
		end)
	end

	if props.PackOrder then
		scope:Hydrate(slotFrame) {
			LayoutOrder = props.PackOrder,
		}
	else
		slotFrame.LayoutOrder = props.SlotIndex
	end

	if props.Visibility then
		scope:Hydrate(slotFrame) {
			Visible = props.Visibility,
		}
	end

	return slotFrame
end

-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return SlotView

local function lockPlayer(player: Player): boolean

		if elapsed < LOCK_TIMEOUT then
			return false
		end

-- Returns the tool template Instance from ServerStorage.Tools, or nil.
-- Lune fallback: if ServerStorage is nil (no Roblox), return a mock tool so tests pass.
local function getToolTemplate(itemId: string): Instance?
	if not ServerStorage then
		return {
			GetAttribute = function(_self: any, _key: string)
				return nil
			end,
		} :: any
	end
	local toolsFolder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Tools")
	if not toolsFolder then return nil end
	return toolsFolder:FindFirstChild(itemId)
end

	return getToolTemplate(itemId) ~= nil

-- Reads a tool template's attributes and returns safe metadata defaults.
-- These are merged UNDER caller-provided metadata (caller wins on conflict).
-- defaultDroppable is the per-player DefaultDroppable setting; it applies
-- only when the template itself does not declare a Droppable attribute.
local function getDefaultMetadata(template: Instance, defaultDroppable: boolean?): Types.ItemMetadata
	local dropDefault = if defaultDroppable == nil then true else defaultDroppable
	return {
		Description = (template:GetAttribute("Description") or "") :: any,
		Image        = (template:GetAttribute("Image") or "") :: any,
		Droppable    = (if template:GetAttribute("Droppable") ~= nil
		               then template:GetAttribute("Droppable")
		               else dropDefault) :: any,
		IsGamepass   = (template:GetAttribute("IsGamepass") or false) :: any,
		Rarity       = (template:GetAttribute("Rarity") or "Common") :: any,
		Type         = (template:GetAttribute("Type") or "Material") :: any,
	}
end

-- Merges defaults under provided; provided values take priority.
local function mergeMetadata(provided: Types.ItemMetadata?, defaults: Types.ItemMetadata): Types.ItemMetadata
	local merged: { [string]: any } = {}
	for k, v in defaults :: { [string]: any } do
		merged[k] = v
	end
	if provided then
		for k, v in provided :: { [string]: any } do
			merged[k] = v
		end
	end
	return merged :: Types.ItemMetadata
end

-- Stamps all item fields as Instance attributes onto a Tool.

	tool:SetAttribute("UUID",   item.UUID)
	tool:SetAttribute("Amount", item.Amount)
	tool:SetAttribute("Id",     item.Id)
	for key, value in item.Metadata :: { [string]: any } do
		tool:SetAttribute(key, value)
	end
end

	end
	if not handle then return end
	local touch = handle:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest")
	if touch then touch:Destroy() end
	handle.CanTouch = false
end

local function dispatch(player: Player, signal: Protocol.Signal)
	for _, adapter in _adapters do
		adapter(player, signal)
	end
end

-- fn receives the (non-nil) CoreStore so it never touches the nullable module field.
local function route(player: Player, operation: Protocol.Operation, replicate: boolean, fn: (cs: CoreStoreApi) -> any): any
	if not lockPlayer(player) then
		return Result.Err({ kind = Result.ErrorKind.NotAvailable, message = "OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS" })
	end

	assert(CoreStore, "CoreStore not initialized")
	local ok, result = pcall(fn, CoreStore)

	if not ok then
		unlockPlayer(player)
		assert(false, `OPERATION_FAILED: {result}`)
	end

	-- Cast is intentional: 'result' is 'any' after pcall, and 'operation' is the
	-- tagged-union discriminant literal this module constructs with the correct
	-- per-operation result type.
	local signal = ({ operation = operation, replicate = replicate, result = result }) :: Protocol.Signal
	dispatch(player, signal)
	unlockPlayer(player)
	return result
end

function Stoway.Start()
	local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
	local PlayerServiceSignals = require(ServerScriptService.Libraries.PlayerServiceSignals)

	PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrAdded:Connect(function(player: Player)
        Log.warn(SharedSettings.getDefault(), player.Name .. " stoway has been created")

        Communications.SendFullSync(player)

    PlayerServiceSignals.BindToPlrRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)

    -- Boot-order race: PlayerService may have fired BindToPlrAdded for

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do

            Stoway.createPlayer(player)

		local state = _store[player]
		if not state then return Result.Err({ kind = EK.NotFound, message = "NO_STATE" }) end

		local item = state.Items[uuid]
		if not item then
			return Result.Err({ kind = EK.NotFound, message = "ITEM_NOT_FOUND" })
		end

		-- Update CoreStore state first
		local result = cs.equip(state, uuid)
		if not result.ok then return result end

		-- Equip Roblox-side: clear stale tools, then clone the template into the character
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			clearCharacterTools(character)
		end
		local template = getToolTemplate(item.Id)
		if character and template then
			local tool = template:Clone()
			applyToolAttributes(tool, item)
			-- The tag is reserved for live world drops. A Studio template may
			-- carry stale CollectionService state, so never equip that tag.
			CollectionService:RemoveTag(tool, STOWAY_DROP_TAG)
			tool.Parent = character  -- parenting a Tool to the Character equips it in Roblox
		end

		return result
	end)

function Stoway.Drop(player: Player, uuid: string, amount: number?, replicate: boolean?): Types.DropResult
	return route(player, "Drop", resolveReplicate(replicate), function(cs: CoreStoreApi): Types.DropResult
		local state = _store[player]
		if not state then
			return Result.Err({ kind = EK.NotFound, message = "NO_STATE" })
		end

		local item = state.Items[uuid]
		if not item then
			return Result.Err({ kind = EK.NotFound, message = "ITEM_NOT_FOUND" })
		end

		if item.Metadata.Droppable == false then
			return Result.Err({ kind = EK.PermissionDenied, message = "NOT_DROPPABLE" })
		end

		local template = getToolTemplate(item.Id)
		if not template then
			return Result.Err({ kind = EK.InvalidArgument, message = "ITEM_NOT_IN_TOOLS_FOLDER" })
		end

		local isEquipped   = state.EquippedItemUUID == uuid
		local dropAmount   = math.min(amount or item.Amount, item.Amount)
		local isFullDrop   = dropAmount >= item.Amount
		local dropCFrame   = getDropCFrame(player)

		-- Find the equipped tool instance in the character now, before state mutates
		local equippedToolInChar: Tool? = nil
		if isEquipped then
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				for _, child in character:GetChildren() do
					if child:IsA("Tool") and child:GetAttribute("UUID") == uuid then
						equippedToolInChar = child :: Tool
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Unequip from CoreStore state only on a full drop of the equipped item
		if isEquipped and isFullDrop then
			cs.unequip(state)
		end

		-- Remove from inventory
		local removeResult = cs.remove(state, uuid, amount)
		if not removeResult.ok then
			return removeResult
		end

		-- Build a snapshot of the dropped item (removedItem is nil for partial removes)
		local droppedSnapshot: Types.Item = removeResult.value.removedItem or {
			UUID     = uuid,
			Id       = item.Id,
			Amount   = dropAmount,
			Metadata = item.Metadata,
		}

		-- Choose which tool instance goes into the world
		local worldTool: Tool
		if equippedToolInChar and isFullDrop then
			-- Equipped + full drop:
			-- Move to Backpack first (visually unequips from the hand), then we reparent to Workspace
			local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
			if backpack then
				equippedToolInChar.Parent = backpack
			end
			equippedToolInChar:SetAttribute("Amount", droppedSnapshot.Amount)
			worldTool = equippedToolInChar
		else
			-- Not equipped, or partial drop: clone a fresh copy for the world
			local cloned = template:Clone() :: Tool
			applyToolAttributes(cloned, droppedSnapshot)
			-- If partial drop on equipped item, update the still-equipped tool's Amount attribute
			if equippedToolInChar then
				equippedToolInChar:SetAttribute("Amount", removeResult.value.remaining or 0)
			end
			worldTool = cloned
		end

		-- Strip default touch pickup and position 5 studs in front of where
		-- the player is looking before making this a live, tagged world drop.
		-- Remove a stale template/equipped tag before re-adding it after the
		-- Workspace parent change. This keeps the tag-added pickup signal valid.
		CollectionService:RemoveTag(worldTool, STOWAY_DROP_TAG)
		stripTouch(worldTool)
		if dropCFrame then
			worldTool:PivotTo(dropCFrame)
		end
		worldTool.Parent = Workspace
		-- Add the tag only after parenting: StowayPickup intentionally ignores
		-- tagged templates in ServerStorage.
		CollectionService:AddTag(worldTool, STOWAY_DROP_TAG)

		return Result.Ok({
			removedItem = droppedSnapshot,
			remaining   = removeResult.value.remaining,
			tool        = worldTool,
		})
	end)
end

-- Code-built skins use fixed design sizes; these gaps are in pixels and
-- are applied relative to the live safe-area + hotbar geometry.
local POPUP_GAP = 12
local POPUP_SIDE_MARGIN = 12
local POPUP_FALLBACK_WIDTH = 440
local POPUP_FALLBACK_HEIGHT = 340
local POPUP_DEFAULT_TOP_OVERHANG = 12

local TOGGLE_GAP = 8
local TOGGLE_SCALE = 0.8
local TOGGLE_MIN = 32
local TOGGLE_MAX = 44

-----------------------------
-- PRIVATE FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- AbsolutePosition/AbsoluteSize are plain properties, not Fusion state.
-- Bump one Value whenever either changes so computed geometry re-runs.
-- The bump is deferred: these signals also fire DURING a Fusion graph
-- change (the hotbar resizing itself), and setting a Value from inside
-- a graph change re-enters the graph and trips Fusion's infinite-loop
-- guard. Deferring moves the update outside the current change.
local function trackGeometry(
	scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>,
	gui: ScreenGui,
	hotbar: Frame
): Fusion.Value<number>
	local tick = scope:Value(0)
	local generation = 0
	local pending = false
	local alive = true
	local function bump()
		pending = false
		if not alive then return end
		generation += 1
		tick:set(generation)
	end
	local function schedule()
		if pending or not alive then return end
		pending = true
		task.defer(bump)
	end
	local tracked: { GuiBase2d } = { gui, hotbar }
	for _, inst in tracked do
		table.insert(scope, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"):Connect(schedule))
		table.insert(scope, inst:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(schedule))
	end
	-- Scope cleanup runs its tasks back-to-front, so this flag flips
	-- before the deferred bump can touch a cleaned-up scope.
	table.insert(scope, function()
		alive = false
	end)
	schedule()
	return tick
end

-- Slots are created by HotbarView before the layout binds responsive UI.
-- Prefer the real slot size; fall back to the hotbar height minus padding.
local function getSlotSize(hotbar: Frame): number
	local first = hotbar:FindFirstChild("Hotbar-1")
	if first and first:IsA("GuiObject") and first.AbsoluteSize.X > 0 then
		return first.AbsoluteSize.X
	end
	for _, child in hotbar:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name:match("^Hotbar%-%d+$") then
			return child.AbsoluteSize.X
		end
	end
	return math.max(0, hotbar.AbsoluteSize.Y - 16)
end

function Shared.doEquipSlot(store: typeof(ClientStore), visibleIndex: number)
	local settings: CoreTypes.Settings? = Fusion.peek(store.Settings)
	local hotbar: { [number]: string? } = Fusion.peek(store.Hotbar)
	local items: { [string]: CoreTypes.Item } = Fusion.peek(store.Items)
	local hotbarType = if settings then settings.HotbarType else "Static"
	local uuid: string?
	if hotbarType == "Dynamic" then
		-- visibleIndex 1.. is packOrder; map to actual slot uuid
		for slot = 1, Shared.getMaxSlots(store) do
			if Query.packedHotbarOrder(hotbar, items, slot, true) == visibleIndex then
				uuid = hotbar[slot]
				break
			end
		end
	else
		uuid = hotbar[visibleIndex]
	end
	if not uuid then
		if Fusion.peek(store.EquippedItemUUID) ~= nil then
			ClientController.Unequip()
		end
		return
	end
	local equipped: string? = Fusion.peek(store.EquippedItemUUID)
	if equipped == uuid then
		ClientController.Unequip()
	else
		ClientController.Equip(uuid)
	end
end

-- The storage toggle button is a mobile-only affordance: PC toggles with
-- keys (Tab/B) and console with DPadLeft, so the on-screen button shows
-- only on Touch while the backpack is enabled. Mirrors the prefab skins,
-- whose BackpackStuff ships Visible=false for the same reason.
function Shared.bindToggleVisible(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>, btn: GuiButton, store: typeof(ClientStore))
	local prefValue: Fusion.Value<EnumItem> = scope:Value(PreferredInput.Get())
	local prefConn = PreferredInput.Changed:Connect(function(newPref: EnumItem)
		prefValue:set(newPref)
	end)
	table.insert(scope, function()
		if prefConn ~= nil then prefConn:Disconnect() end
	end)
	scope:Hydrate(btn) {
		Visible = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): boolean
			local s: CoreTypes.Settings? = use(store.Settings)
			local backpackEnabled = s == nil or s.BackpackEnabled ~= false
			if not backpackEnabled then return false end
			return use(prefValue) == Enum.PreferredInput.Touch
		end),
	}
end

-- Code-built skins have no authored responsive geometry. Keep their
-- popup above the hotbar and their mobile toggle above the left slots,
-- using the live safe-area/hotbar rectangles rather than camera math.
-- Prefab skins do not call this path.
function Shared.bindResponsiveUi(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>, skin: CoreTypes.SkinHandle)
	if skin.ResponsiveUi ~= true then
		return
	end
	local gui = skin.Gui
	local hotbar = skin.HotbarFrame
	if not gui or not hotbar then
		return
	end
	local geometry = trackGeometry(scope, gui, hotbar)

	local popup = skin.BackpackFrame
	if popup then
		local popupWidth = if popup.Size.X.Offset > 0 then popup.Size.X.Offset else POPUP_FALLBACK_WIDTH
		local popupHeight = if popup.Size.Y.Offset > 0 then popup.Size.Y.Offset else POPUP_FALLBACK_HEIGHT
		local topOverhang = skin.PopupTopOverhang or POPUP_DEFAULT_TOP_OVERHANG
		scope:Hydrate(popup) {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Position = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): UDim2
				use(geometry)
				local guiPosition = gui.AbsolutePosition
				local guiSize = gui.AbsoluteSize
				local hotbarPosition = hotbar.AbsolutePosition
				local reserve = math.max(0, guiPosition.Y + guiSize.Y - hotbarPosition.Y) + POPUP_GAP
				return UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -reserve)
			end),
			Size = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): UDim2
				use(geometry)
				local guiPosition = gui.AbsolutePosition
				local guiSize = gui.AbsoluteSize
				local hotbarPosition = hotbar.AbsolutePosition
				local width = math.min(popupWidth, math.max(1, guiSize.X - POPUP_SIDE_MARGIN * 2))
				local available = math.max(1, hotbarPosition.Y - guiPosition.Y - POPUP_GAP - topOverhang)
				return UDim2.fromOffset(width, math.min(popupHeight, available))
			end),
		}
	end

	local toggle = skin.BackpackStuff
	if toggle then
		scope:Hydrate(toggle) {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
			Size = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): UDim2
				use(geometry)
				local size = math.clamp(getSlotSize(hotbar) * TOGGLE_SCALE, TOGGLE_MIN, TOGGLE_MAX)
				return UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
			end),
			Position = scope:Computed(function(use: Fusion.Use): UDim2
				use(geometry)
				local guiPosition = gui.AbsolutePosition
				local guiSize = gui.AbsoluteSize
				local hotbarPosition = hotbar.AbsolutePosition
				local size = math.clamp(getSlotSize(hotbar) * TOGGLE_SCALE, TOGGLE_MIN, TOGGLE_MAX)
				local reserve = math.max(0, guiPosition.Y + guiSize.Y - hotbarPosition.Y) + TOGGLE_GAP
				local centerX = hotbarPosition.X + size / 2
				local offsetX = centerX - (guiPosition.X + guiSize.X / 2)
				return UDim2.new(0.5, offsetX, 1, -reserve)
			end),
		}
	end
end

function Shared.ensureDraggingGui(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>, skin: CoreTypes.SkinHandle): ScreenGui
	local existingDragging = skin.DraggingGui

	if existingDragging then
