--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-10-20
--[[@description:
	Persona FX runtime. One-shot slot effects for the Persona hooks:
	elastic kicks (scale / tilt / shake), white flash, edge flicker, impact
	slashes, shockwave ring and the equipped-bar pulse. Plain TweenService
	only: no Fusion objects per event and no per-frame loop, so nothing
	keeps running while idle and there is nothing to leak.

	Bursts and rings are parented to the skin's FX layer (a full-screen
	overlay), never to the slot, so the storage ScrollingFrame can't clip
	them. Every method is safe to call on a destroyed slot or after Destroy.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)

local PersonaFx = {}
PersonaFx.__index = PersonaFx

-----------------------------
-- TYPES --
-----------------------------

export type KickSpec = {
	Scale: number?, -- start scale offset (+ grows, - squashes)
	Rot: number?, -- start tilt offset in degrees (sign alternates per kick)
	Shake: number?, -- start offset in px, random direction
	Time: number?, -- settle time in seconds
}

type SelfData = {
	_layer: Frame,
	_destroyed: boolean,
	_sign: number,
	_active: number,
	_idle: { [string]: Tween? },
	_edgeTweens: { [UIStroke]: Tween? },
	_liftToken: { [GuiObject]: number },
}

export type Fx = typeof(setmetatable({} :: SelfData, PersonaFx))

-----------------------------
-- CONSTANTS --
-----------------------------

local LIFT_Z = 10 -- slot ZIndex while a kick plays, so it draws over neighbours
local MAX_ACTIVE = 64 -- cap on live burst/ring frames (fast sweeps spam bursts)

local SLASH_TIME = 0.24
local SLASH_MOVE = TweenInfo.new(SLASH_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local SLASH_FADE = TweenInfo.new(SLASH_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

local RING_TIME = 0.32
local RING_INFO = TweenInfo.new(RING_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local FLASH_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local FLICKER_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
-- Equipped bar pulse: red <-> white forever until cancelled.
local IDLE_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)

-----------------------------
-- PRIVATE FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- UIScale on the card, so a scale kick never fights the slot frame's own
-- Size binding or the layout's swap-pop UIScale (that one lives on the
-- slot frame, this one on the button inside it).
local function punchScale(btn: GuiButton): UIScale
	local existing = btn:FindFirstChild("PunchScale")
	if existing ~= nil and existing:IsA("UIScale") then
		return existing :: UIScale
	end
	local created = Instance.new("UIScale")
	created.Name = "PunchScale"
	created.Parent = btn
	return created
end

-- Centre of target in the FX layer's coordinate space, plus its half-size.
local function centerIn(layer: Frame, target: GuiObject): (Vector2?, number)
	local size = target.AbsoluteSize
	if size.X <= 0 or size.Y <= 0 then
		return nil, 0
	end
	local center = target.AbsolutePosition + size * 0.5 - layer.AbsolutePosition
	return center, math.min(size.X, size.Y) * 0.5
end

-- Raise the slot above its siblings for the length of a kick. Token-based
-- so overlapping kicks don't restore early.
local function liftSlot(self: Fx, slot: GuiObject, seconds: number)
	local token = (self._liftToken[slot] or 0) + 1
	self._liftToken[slot] = token
	slot.ZIndex = LIFT_Z
	task.delay(seconds, function()
		if self._liftToken[slot] == token then
			self._liftToken[slot] = nil
			if slot.Parent ~= nil then
				slot.ZIndex = 1
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function newStroke(parent: Instance, color: Color3, thickness: number): UIStroke
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = color
	stroke.Thickness = thickness
	stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter
	stroke.Parent = parent
	return stroke
end

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

function PersonaFx.new(layer: Frame): Fx
	local self = setmetatable({
		_layer = layer,
		_destroyed = false,
		_sign = 1,
		_active = 0,
		_idle = {},
		_edgeTweens = {},
		_liftToken = {},
	} :: SelfData, PersonaFx)
	return self
end

-- Elastic kick on a slot's card: jumps to the offset instantly, then
-- rings back to rest. Scale, tilt and shake settle together.
function PersonaFx.Kick(self: Fx, btn: GuiButton, spec: KickSpec)
	if self._destroyed or btn.Parent == nil or not btn.Visible then return end

	local seconds = spec.Time or 0.5
	local scale = punchScale(btn)
	scale.Scale = math.max(1 + (spec.Scale or 0), 0.1)

	self._sign = -self._sign
	btn.Rotation = Theme.TILT + self._sign * (spec.Rot or 0)

	local shake = spec.Shake or 0
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	btn.Position = Theme.CARD_POS + UDim2.fromOffset(math.cos(angle) * shake, math.sin(angle) * shake)

	local info = TweenInfo.new(seconds, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	TweenService:Create(scale, info, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(btn, info, { Rotation = Theme.TILT, Position = Theme.CARD_POS }):Play()

	local slot = btn.Parent
	if slot and slot:IsA("GuiObject") then
		liftSlot(self, slot, seconds)
	end
end

-- Stamp-in: starts small and tilted, rings up past full size.
function PersonaFx.PopIn(self: Fx, btn: GuiButton)
	self:Kick(btn, { Scale = -0.75, Rot = 12, Shake = 0, Time = 0.55 })
end

-- White (or tinted) overlay on the card that fades out.
function PersonaFx.Flash(self: Fx, btn: GuiButton, color: Color3, strength: number)
	if self._destroyed or btn.Parent == nil then return end
	local flash = btn:FindFirstChild("Flash")
	if flash == nil or not flash:IsA("Frame") then return end
	flash.BackgroundColor3 = color
	flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(strength, 0, 1)
	TweenService:Create(flash, FLASH_INFO, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
end

-- Outline snaps to colour/thick, then eases back to the resting look.
function PersonaFx.Flicker(self: Fx, btn: GuiButton, color: Color3)
	if self._destroyed or btn.Parent == nil then return end
	local edge = btn:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	if edge == nil or not edge:IsA("UIStroke") then return end
	edge.Color = color
	edge.Thickness = Theme.EDGE_HOT
	local tween = TweenService:Create(edge, FLICKER_INFO, { Color = Theme.STEEL, Thickness = Theme.EDGE_THICKNESS })
	self._edgeTweens[edge] = tween
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Once(function()
		if self._edgeTweens[edge] == tween then
			self._edgeTweens[edge] = nil
		end
	end)
end

-- Hold the outline hot (red, hover-hot thickness) while the card is the
-- current drag target. on = false drops it straight back to the resting
-- look, so only one card is ever lit.
function PersonaFx.SetHot(self: Fx, btn: GuiButton, on: boolean)
	if self._destroyed or btn.Parent == nil then return end
	local edge = btn:FindFirstChild("Edge")
	if edge == nil or not edge:IsA("UIStroke") then return end
	local running = self._edgeTweens[edge]
	if running ~= nil then
		running:Cancel()
		self._edgeTweens[edge] = nil
	end
	if on then
		edge.Color = Theme.RED
		edge.Thickness = Theme.EDGE_HOT
	else
		edge.Color = Theme.STEEL
		edge.Thickness = Theme.EDGE_THICKNESS
	end
end

-- Impact slashes radiating from the target's centre (the combo counter's
-- slash ring). Frames are created per burst and destroyed on a timer.
function PersonaFx.Burst(self: Fx, target: GuiObject, color: Color3, count: number, power: number)
	if self._destroyed then return end
	local center, radius = centerIn(self._layer, target)
	if center == nil then return end

	local base = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local width = math.max(3, radius * 0.13)
	local length = radius * 0.95
	local startDist = radius * 0.9
	local travel = radius * 1.25 * power

	for i = 1, count do
		if self._active >= MAX_ACTIVE then break end
		self._active += 1

		local angle = base + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / count) + math.rad(math.random(-14, 14))
		local dir = Vector2.new(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
		local from = center + dir * startDist
		local to = center + dir * (startDist + travel)

		local slash = Instance.new("Frame")
		slash.Name = "Slash"
		slash.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		slash.BackgroundColor3 = color
		slash.BorderSizePixel = 0
		slash.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(from.X, from.Y)
		slash.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, length)
		slash.Rotation = math.deg(angle) - 90
		local stroke = newStroke(slash, Theme.INK, 1.5)
		slash.Parent = self._layer

		TweenService:Create(slash, SLASH_MOVE, {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(to.X, to.Y),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, length * 0.45),
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(slash, SLASH_FADE, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
		TweenService:Create(stroke, SLASH_FADE, { Transparency = 1 }):Play()

		task.delay(SLASH_TIME + 0.05, function()
			self._active -= 1
			slash:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end

-- Hollow tilted square that expands past the slot and fades: the stamp
-- shockwave under a burst.
function PersonaFx.Ring(self: Fx, target: GuiObject, color: Color3, grow: number)
	if self._destroyed or self._active >= MAX_ACTIVE then return end
	local center, radius = centerIn(self._layer, target)
	if center == nil then return end
	self._active += 1

	local start = math.max(radius * 2 - Theme.CARD_INSET, 4)
	local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
	ring.Name = "Ring"
	ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
	ring.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(center.X, center.Y)
	ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(start, start)
	ring.Rotation = Theme.TILT
	local stroke = newStroke(ring, color, 4)
	ring.Parent = self._layer

	local finish = start * grow
	TweenService:Create(ring, RING_INFO, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(finish, finish) }):Play()
	TweenService:Create(stroke, RING_INFO, { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 1 }):Play()

	task.delay(RING_TIME + 0.05, function()
		self._active -= 1
		ring:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Equipped-bar pulse (red <-> white) for as long as the slot stays
-- selected. Keyed by slot name, so a storage slot that got rebuilt
-- mid-selection still has its old pulse cancelled on deselect.
function PersonaFx.SetIdle(self: Fx, slot: GuiObject, on: boolean)
	local key = slot.Name
	local running = self._idle[key]
	if running ~= nil then
		running:Cancel()
		self._idle[key] = nil
	end

	local bar = slot:FindFirstChild("selecticon")
	if bar == nil or not bar:IsA("ImageLabel") then return end
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.RED

	if on and not self._destroyed then
		local tween = TweenService:Create(bar, IDLE_INFO, { BackgroundColor3 = Theme.WHITE })
		self._idle[key] = tween
		tween:Play()
	end
end

function PersonaFx.Destroy(self: Fx)
	self._destroyed = true
	for key, tween in self._idle do
		if tween ~= nil then
			tween:Cancel()
		end
		self._idle[key] = nil
	end
	for edge, tween in self._edgeTweens do
		if tween ~= nil then
			tween:Cancel()
		end
		self._edgeTweens[edge] = nil
	end
end

-- MAIN --

return PersonaFx

--@date: 2026-10-20
--[[@description:
	Persona skin hooks (Layer 2). The full 11-name contract, each one wired
	to a punch from Persona.Fx. Built per mount (not a static table)
	because the hooks need the live hotbar / storage containers to find the
	slot a (slotType, index) payload points at: payloads never carry
	frames, subscribers resolve visuals themselves (see ClientEvents).

	Who does what:
	  state changes   OnEquip / OnUnequip / OnItemAdd / OnItemRemove / OnSwap
	                  -> the big beats (kick + flash + slashes + ring)
	  held state      OnSelect / OnDeselect -> equipped-bar pulse for as long
	                  as the slot stays selected (SlotView only fires these
	                  for templates with a selecticon, which Persona has)
	  pointer         OnSlotHover / OnSlotClick / OnDragStart / OnDragEnd
	                  -> small feedback, deliberately quieter than the beats

	Hooks are spawned + pcall'd by ClientEvents.CallHook, so yielding here
	(the one-frame settle wait) never stalls input, and a throw only warns.
]]

-----------------------------

local CoreTypes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local PersonaFx = require(script.Parent.Fx)

local PersonaHooks = {}

export type Targets = {
	Hotbar: Frame,
	Storage: ScrollingFrame,
	Backpack: Frame,
}

-- CONSTANTS --
-----------------------------

-- Tuning lives here: every number the feel depends on, in one place.
local TUNE = {
	Hover = { Scale = 0.08, Rot = 3, Shake = 1.5, Time = 0.35 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	Click = { Scale = -0.14, Rot = 2, Shake = 0, Time = 0.35 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	Equip = { Scale = 0.32, Rot = 8, Shake = 5, Time = 0.55 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	Unequip = { Scale = -0.2, Rot = 4, Shake = 0, Time = 0.4 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	Swap = { Scale = 0.2, Rot = 7, Shake = 3, Time = 0.45 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	DragStart = { Scale = 0.18, Rot = 6, Shake = 0, Time = 0.4 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
	DragEnd = { Scale = -0.1, Rot = 3, Shake = 0, Time = 0.35 } :: PersonaFx.KickSpec,
}

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

function PersonaHooks.new(fx: PersonaFx.Fx, targets: Targets): CoreTypes.HookMap
	-- Slot frames are named "<SlotType>-<index>" by SlotView and sit
	-- directly under the hotbar / the storage ScrollingFrame.
	local function slotFrame(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number): Frame?
		-- A closed popup has nothing to animate.
		if slotType == "Storage" and not targets.Backpack.Visible then return nil end
		local container: Instance = if slotType == "Hotbar" then targets.Hotbar else targets.Storage
		local found = container:FindFirstChild(`{slotType}-{index}`)
		if found ~= nil and found:IsA("Frame") then
			return found :: Frame
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function buttonOf(frame: Frame?): GuiButton?
		if frame == nil then return nil end
		local btn = frame:FindFirstChild("slotbutton")
		if btn ~= nil and btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return btn :: GuiButton
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- State hooks fire right after the store sync, so a storage slot the
	-- sync just rebuilt may not have been laid out yet (size 0). Give the
	-- layout one frame, then look the slot up again.
	local function settled(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number): (Frame?, GuiButton?)
		local frame = slotFrame(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil or frame.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
			task.wait()
			frame = slotFrame(slotType, index)
		end
		if frame == nil or frame.AbsoluteSize.X <= 0 then
			return nil, nil
		end
		return frame, buttonOf(frame)
	end

	local hooks: CoreTypes.HookMap = {}

	-- Drag state. The sweep arms on the pressed slot, but the highlight
	-- belongs to the slot under the pointer: the one being swapped to.
	local dragging = false
	local held: GuiButton? = nil
	local lastHovered: GuiButton? = nil

	local function clearHeld()
		if held == nil then return end
		fx:SetHot(held, false)
		held = nil
	end

	-- Move the marker to a slot: only one card is ever lit.
	local function hold(btn: GuiButton)
		if held == btn then return end
		clearHeld()
		fx:SetHot(btn, true)
		held = btn
	end

	-----------------------------
	-- POINTER (quiet) --
	-----------------------------

	-- Hover: tilt wobble + the outline flashes red and cools back down.
	-- Mid-drag it becomes the target marker: the outline of the slot under
	-- the pointer stays hot, the previous one drops it.
	hooks.OnSlotHover = function(btn: GuiButton, _slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, _slotIndex: number)
		lastHovered = btn
		if dragging then
			hold(btn)
			return
		end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.Hover)
		fx:Flicker(btn, Theme.RED)
	end

	-- Click: press-in squash + a thin white flash. The equip/unequip beat
	-- follows from the state hook, so this stays small.
	hooks.OnSlotClick = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number, _uuid: string?)
		local btn = buttonOf(slotFrame(slotType, index))
		if btn == nil then return end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.Click)
		fx:Flash(btn, Theme.WHITE, 0.35)
	end

	-- Sweep armed: the pressed card lifts. The highlight does NOT go here
	-- - it follows the pointer to the slot being swapped to.
	hooks.OnDragStart = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		dragging = true
		local btn = buttonOf(slotFrame(slotType, index))
		if btn == nil then return end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.DragStart)
		-- A fast flick can already be over the next slot when the sweep
		-- arms: take the marker with it instead of waiting for a hover.
		if lastHovered ~= nil and lastHovered ~= btn then
			hold(lastHovered)
		end
	end

	-- Sweep over: the card the stroke ended on settles with a soft thud
	-- and the target marker drops. The source slot gets no highlight.
	hooks.OnDragEnd = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		dragging = false
		local target = held
		clearHeld()
		if target ~= nil then
			fx:Kick(target, TUNE.DragEnd)
		end
	end

	-----------------------------
	-- STATE (the beats) --
	-----------------------------

	-- Equip: the loudest one. Slam, white flash, red shockwave, red slashes.
	hooks.OnEquip = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		local frame, btn = settled(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil or btn == nil then return end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.Equip)
		fx:Flash(btn, Theme.WHITE, 0.85)
		fx:Ring(frame, Theme.RED, 1.9)
		fx:Burst(frame, Theme.RED, 8, 1.2)
	end

	-- Unequip: the card dips and a few white slashes fall away.
	hooks.OnUnequip = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		local frame, btn = settled(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil or btn == nil then return end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.Unequip)
		fx:Flash(btn, Theme.WHITE, 0.3)
		fx:Burst(frame, Theme.WHITE, 3, 0.55)
	end

	-- Add: the new item stamps in from small, white ring + slashes.
	hooks.OnItemAdd = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		local frame, btn = settled(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil or btn == nil then return end
		fx:PopIn(btn)
		fx:Flash(btn, Theme.WHITE, 0.8)
		fx:Ring(frame, Theme.WHITE, 1.7)
		fx:Burst(frame, Theme.WHITE, 5, 0.85)
	end

	-- Remove: the card is already gone, so only the shatter is left. Red
	-- slashes burst from the empty slot.
	hooks.OnItemRemove = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		local frame = settled(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil then return end
		fx:Ring(frame, Theme.RED, 1.5)
		fx:Burst(frame, Theme.RED, 6, 0.9)
	end

	-- Swap: fires for the destination slot (the layout already pops both
	-- endpoints). Kept short because a sweep ripple fires it per crossing.
	hooks.OnSwap = function(slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, index: number)
		local frame, btn = settled(slotType, index)
		if frame == nil or btn == nil then return end
		fx:Kick(btn, TUNE.Swap)
		fx:Flash(btn, Theme.WHITE, 0.5)
		fx:Burst(frame, Theme.WHITE, 4, 0.7)
	end

	-----------------------------
	-- HELD STATE --
	-----------------------------

	-- Select/Deselect carry the slot frame itself. SlotView fires them from
	-- the equipped observer, which only runs on a change, so a slot that is
	-- already equipped at mount gets the red bar but no pulse until it is
	-- re-selected.
	hooks.OnSelect = function(frame: Frame, _slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, _slotIndex: number)
		fx:SetIdle(frame, true)
	end

	hooks.OnDeselect = function(frame: Frame, _slotType: CoreTypes.SlotType, _slotIndex: number)
		fx:SetIdle(frame, false)
	end

	return hooks
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return PersonaHooks

	name: string,
	parent: Instance,

	position: UDim2,
	size: UDim2,

-- Persona slot template. SlotView clones + hydrates it per slot. ZIndex
-- ladder: plate 0 < teamframe 1 < slotbutton 2 < selecticon 3 < stackcount
-- 3 (SlotView forces it) < slotnumber 4.
local function buildSlotTemplate(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>): Frame
	local template = scope:New("Frame") {
		Name = "template",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	} :: Frame

	-- Empty-slot hint: dim ink card so the hotbar reads as a row of
	-- slots even with nothing in it.
	local plate = slab(scope, "plate", template, Theme.INK, Theme.CARD_POS, Theme.CARD_SIZE, 0)
	plate.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
	outline(scope, plate, Theme.PLATE_EDGE, 2)

	-- Shard: peeks out down-right of the card. SlotView tints it from
	-- Metadata.Team and shows it only while the slot holds an item.
	slab(
		scope,
		"teamframe",
		template,
		Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),
		UDim2.new(0.5, Theme.SHARD_OFFSET, 0.5, Theme.SHARD_OFFSET),
		Theme.CARD_SIZE,
		1
	)

	local slotbutton = scope:New("ImageButton") {
		Name = "slotbutton",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = Theme.CARD_POS,
		Size = Theme.CARD_SIZE,
		Rotation = Theme.TILT,
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.INK,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Image = "",
		ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		ZIndex = 2,
		Parent = template,
	} :: ImageButton
	outline(scope, slotbutton, Theme.STEEL, Theme.EDGE_THICKNESS, "Edge")

	-- White overlay for Fx.Flash. Child of the card so it tilts with it.
	scope:New("Frame") {
		Name = "Flash",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.WHITE,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ZIndex = 5,
		Parent = slotbutton,
	}

	-- Equipped bar. SlotView shows it while equipped and pops its Size;
	-- the Persona hooks only ever touch its colour (idle pulse). ZIndex 3
	-- draws it ON the card (the card sits at 2), never behind it.
	scope:New("ImageLabel") {
		Name = "selecticon",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 3, 1, 1),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 5),

		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.RED,

		Image = "",

		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = template,

	label(scope, "stackcount", template, 16, 3)

	local slotnumber = label(scope, "slotnumber", template, 20, 4)
	slotnumber.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
	slotnumber.Position = UDim2.new(0, -3, 1, 2)
	slotnumber.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20)
	slotnumber.Rotation = Theme.TILT

	return template
end

		FontFace = Theme.FONT,
		TextScaled = true,
		TextSize = 18,
		TextColor3 = Theme.WHITE,
		Text = "≡",
		ZIndex = 3,
		Parent = face,
	} :: TextLabel
	scope:New("UITextSizeConstraint") {
		MaxTextSize = 18,
		MinTextSize = 10,
		Parent = glyph,
	}

	local template = buildSlotTemplate(scope)

	-- FX overlay: bursts and rings live here, never inside a slot, so the
	-- storage ScrollingFrame can't clip them. Not Active: input falls
	-- straight through to the slots underneath.
	local fxLayer = scope:New("Frame") {
		Name = "Fx",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Active = false,
		ZIndex = 100,
		Parent = gui,
	} :: Frame
	local fx = PersonaFx.new(fxLayer)
	table.insert(scope, function()
		fx:Destroy()
	end)
	local hooks = PersonaHooks.new(fx, {
		Hotbar = hotbar,
		Storage = scrolling,
		Backpack = backpack,
	})

	-- Shared DraggingGui singleton (same rule as SkinLoader): adopt the
	-- live one, else create scope-owned. Unused by sweep mode, kept so
	-- the handle stays complete.
	local existingDragging = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DraggingGui") :: ScreenGui?
	local draggingGui: ScreenGui
	if existingDragging then
		existingDragging.IgnoreGuiInset = false
		draggingGui = existingDragging
	else
		draggingGui = scope:New("ScreenGui") {
			Name = "DraggingGui",
			DisplayOrder = 100,
			IgnoreGuiInset = false,
			ResetOnSpawn = false,
			Parent = playerGui,
		} :: ScreenGui
	end

	return {
		Gui = gui,
		HotbarFrame = hotbar,
		BackpackFrame = backpack,
		ScrollingFrame = scrolling,
		WeightLabel = weight,
		BackpackStuff = toggle,
		SlotTemplate = template,
		DraggingGui = draggingGui,
		SlotBleedPx = Theme.BLEED,
		-- Code-built skin: the layout owns popup/toggle geometry.
		ResponsiveUi = true,
		-- The title tag hangs over the popup's top edge.
		PopupTopOverhang = 20,
		-- Category headers follow the Persona language: ink bar, white
		-- miter outline, theme font.
		HeaderStyle = {
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.INK,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			TextColor3 = Theme.WHITE,
			TextSize = 14,
			FontFace = Theme.FONT,
			CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0),
			StrokeColor = Theme.WHITE,
			StrokeThickness = 1.5,
			StrokeLineJoin = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter,
			PaddingLeft = 14,
			PaddingRight = 10,
		},
		Hooks = hooks,
	}
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return PersonaSkin

--@author: yyumchi
--@date: 2026-08-19
--[[@description:
	Generic skin loader. Clones the named skin folder's single ScreenGui
	and returns handles to its frames for the layout. Per-skin modules
	(Default, Modern, Metal) re-export this; the UiSkin key IS the
	ReplicatedStorage.Stoway.GUI asset folder, so a key can only ever
	mount its own GUI.
]]
-----------------------------
-- VARIABLES --
-----------------------------

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Fusion = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.fusion)

local CoreTypes = require(script.Parent.Parent.CoreStore.Types)
local ClientStore = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controller.ClientStore)
local Log = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Stoway.Log)

local SkinLoader = {}

-- Parse a comma-separated Studio attribute into a name list. Non-strings
-- and empties resolve to nil (caller falls back to built-in defaults).
local function parseNameList(value: unknown): { string }?
	if typeof(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local names: { string } = {}
	for part in string.gmatch(value, "[^,]+") do
		local trimmed = string.match(part, "^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
		if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(names, trimmed) end
	end
	if #names == 0 then return nil end
	return names
end

local function parseBleedPx(value: unknown): number?
	if typeof(value) == "number" then return value end
	return nil
end

-----------------------------
-- PUBLIC FUNCTIONS --
-----------------------------

-- Loads the skin GUI onto the given scope.
function SkinLoader.Load(scope: Fusion.Scope<typeof(Fusion)>, playerGui: PlayerGui, skinAssetName: string): CoreTypes.SkinHandle?
	local guiRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Stoway")
	local guiFolder = guiRoot and guiRoot:FindFirstChild("GUI")
	local skinFolder = guiFolder and guiFolder:FindFirstChild(skinAssetName)

	if not skinFolder then
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[SkinLoader] skin asset '{skinAssetName}' not found at ReplicatedStorage.Stoway.GUI`)
		return nil
	end

	-- Flat shape only: exactly one ScreenGui directly under the skin folder.
	local guiTemplate: ScreenGui? = nil
	local guiCount = 0
	for _, child in skinFolder:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			guiCount += 1
			guiTemplate = child
		end
	end
	if not guiTemplate then
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[SkinLoader] skin asset '{skinAssetName}' must contain exactly one ScreenGui (found {guiCount})`)
		return nil
	end
	if guiCount ~= 1 then
		Log.warn(ClientStore.GetSettings(), `[SkinLoader] skin asset '{skinAssetName}' must contain exactly one ScreenGui (found {guiCount})`)
		return nil
	end

	-- Skin hook adapter (Layer 2): require the HookFuncs ModuleScript
	-- from the skin folder when present. Absent/failed = nil hooks and
	-- everything still works (absent = legacy, same rule as slot attrs).
	-- Validated against the 11-name contract; unknown entries warn.
	local hookFuncs: CoreTypes.HookMap? = nil
	local hookFolder = skinFolder:FindFirstChild("HookFuncs")
	if hookFolder then
		local hookModule: ModuleScript? = nil
		for _, child in hookFolder:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				hookModule = child
				break
			end
		end
		if hookModule then
			local ok, required = pcall(require, hookModule)
			if ok and typeof(required) == "table" then
				local validated: CoreTypes.HookMap = required :: CoreTypes.HookMap
				for name, fn in validated do
					if typeof(fn) ~= "function" then
						warn(`[SkinLoader] hook '{name}' in '{skinAssetName}' is not a function, ignoring`)
						validated[name] = nil
					end
				end
				hookFuncs = validated
			else
				warn(`[SkinLoader] HookFuncs in '{skinAssetName}' failed to require: {tostring(required)}`)
			end
		end
	end

	local gui = guiTemplate:Clone() :: ScreenGui
	gui.Parent = playerGui
	table.insert(scope, gui)

	local backpack = gui:FindFirstChild("Backpack") :: Frame?
	local slotFolder = skinFolder:FindFirstChild("Slot")
	local selectionCursor = slotFolder and (slotFolder:FindFirstChild("SelectionCursor") :: GuiObject?)

	-- Optional per-skin declarations on the Slot folder (absent = defaults).
	local ghostHidden: { string }? = if slotFolder then parseNameList(slotFolder:GetAttribute("GhostHidden")) else nil
	local hideInStorage: { string }? = if slotFolder then parseNameList(slotFolder:GetAttribute("HideInStorage")) else nil
	local hideInHotbar: { string }? = if slotFolder then parseNameList(slotFolder:GetAttribute("HideInHotbar")) else nil
	local slotBleedPx: number? = if slotFolder then parseBleedPx(slotFolder:GetAttribute("SlotBleedPx")) else nil

	-- Single shared DraggingGui: prefer the live one already in PlayerGui.
	-- The folder lookup alone misses it (it moved out on first mount), which
	-- used to strand the template in PlayerGui and clone a duplicate on
	-- every skin switch. Adopt it, destroy any extras, else fall back to the
	-- folder template (moved, never scope-owned — it is shared), else create
	-- scope-owned as a last resort.
	local existingDragging = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DraggingGui") :: ScreenGui?
	if existingDragging == nil then
		existingDragging = guiFolder and (guiFolder:FindFirstChild("DraggingGui") :: ScreenGui?)
	end
	local draggingGui: ScreenGui
	if existingDragging then
		existingDragging.IgnoreGuiInset = false
		if existingDragging.Parent ~= playerGui then existingDragging.Parent = playerGui end
		draggingGui = existingDragging
	else
		local created = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		created.Name = "DraggingGui"
		created.DisplayOrder = 100
		created.IgnoreGuiInset = false
		created.ResetOnSpawn = false
		created.Parent = playerGui
		table.insert(scope, created)
		draggingGui = created
	end
	for _, child in playerGui:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child.Name == "DraggingGui" and child ~= draggingGui then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	return {
		Gui = gui,
		HotbarFrame = gui:FindFirstChild("Hotbar") :: Frame?,
		BackpackFrame = backpack,
		ScrollingFrame = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("ScrollingFrame") :: ScrollingFrame?),
		WeightLabel = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("Weight") :: TextLabel?),
		SearchFilter = backpack and (backpack:FindFirstChild("SearchFilter") :: TextBox?),
		BackpackStuff = gui:FindFirstChild("BackpackStuff") :: ImageButton?,
		SlotTemplate = slotFolder and (slotFolder:FindFirstChild("template") :: Frame?),
		DraggingGui = draggingGui,
		SelectionCursorTemplate = selectionCursor,
		GhostHidden = ghostHidden,
		HideInStorage = hideInStorage,
		HideInHotbar = hideInHotbar,
		SlotBleedPx = slotBleedPx,
		Hooks = hookFuncs,
	}
end

-----------------------------
-- MAIN --
-----------------------------

return SkinLoader
